page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 752.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.88 GB per core. For acceleration, the instance integrates four NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs, delivering a total of 96 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, this instance demonstrates strong multi-core and memory performance. The stress-ng multi-core CPU metric is rated as strong at 123,935.69, while single-core performance is average at 1,882.5. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with small-block cached reads reaching 6,856.96 GB/sec and large-block uncached reads at 253.9 GB/sec. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieves a top-tier score of 575.13 GB/sec. Additionally, the instance handles high-throughput workloads effectively, registering 100.72 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 61.52 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of 128 dedicated cores and four enterprise-grade GPUs offers a highly consolidated hardware profile for parallel processing tasks. The primary tradeoff is the complete absence of local SSD storage, which necessitates reliance on network storage and may impact I/O-heavy operations if not properly architected. This instance is optimized for GPU-accelerated workloads, deep learning inference, high-performance computing, multi-threaded data decompression, and large-scale web serving applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a high-performance, GPU-accelerated server instance designed for intensive parallel computing. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it features 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B cores clocked at 2.9 GHz, paired with 752.0 GB of system memory. Graphics and compute acceleration are driven by four NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs with a combined 96 GB of VRAM. The instance lacks local storage but provides a robust 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 123,935.69 and top-tier multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 575.13 GB/sec. It also exhibits strong memory bandwidth and high Redis throughput. This configuration is highly suited for GPU-accelerated workloads, deep learning, and complex multi-threaded simulations, though users must provision external storage.
